analyst_view.overall: Early view: Kasimpasa (5th) have lost once all season and will be about a month into Alfred Schreuder's time in charge; Goztepe (10th) under Stoilov were on a four-game winning run before losing at home to Basaksehir. It is a Monday-night game and both sides have two more league games before it, so this is a first read.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals and I lean slightly higher. Goztepe's eleven games have produced 41 goals, and while Kasimpasa's are lower scoring, they drew 2-2 with Besiktas and won 2-0 at Gaziantep in their last two.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.4 corners. Both sides like to attack and the forecast split is even, so I stay with it.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.8 cards. No suspensions or flashpoints are known this far out, so I stay near the number.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.2 shots. Goztepe's games are open and Kasimpasa have attacking players in Hajradinovic, Benedyczak and Kerem Demirbay, so the number looks fair.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.0 shots on target. That fits two attacks of similar quality, and I would revisit it once Schreuder's approach is clearer.
